caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, floor-length red dress displayed against a plain, light beige background. The dress features a fitted bodice with vertical pleats and a full skirt that extends outward near the hem. The front of the dress is adorned with a single row of round yellowish buttons that run from the collar down to the hem. There are two square-shaped pockets, one on each side of the dress at hip level. The dress includes a small pointed collar at the neckline and subtle decorative frills at the cuffs and the lower hem. A small, semi-circular fan-shaped object is placed at the top center where a head would be, but there is no visible head or human form; only the dress and the fan-like item are present in the composition. The shades of red on the dress range from deep crimson to lighter pinkish-red areas, indicating light and shadow on the fabric.
title: Tea Gown
